label: rem:q-oper-remark
title: Rank-2 $q$-opers as $q$-Sturm--Liouville operators
html: For a q-oper in the rank-2 case \check{G}_q = \mathrm{SU}_{q^{-1}}(2), a q-oper on a brane curve X is a rank-2 q-flat bundle with an invariant line subbundle \mathcal{L} \subset \mathcal{V} satisfying the transversality condition \nabla_q(\mathcal{L}) \not\subset \mathcal{L} \otimes \Omega^1_q. This geometric data is equivalent to a q-deformed Sturm--Liouville operator \partial_q^2 + t(z), where t(z) \in H^0(X, (\Omega^1_q)^{\otimes 2}), providing the rigid spectral data dual to q-Hecke eigensheaves.
heading: Remark
